content:
nina: quick UX thread — thinking about adding a small "Schema diff" affordance to run history rows when a tool output schema changes between versions. idea: a subtle chevron with a tiny badge 'diff' that opens a compact inline diff panel. thoughts?

sam: ooh useful. question: should diff show structural changes only (fields added/removed/renamed) or also example value diffs? both could be noisy.

maya: prefer structural-first. value diffs are noisy and often environment-specific. show example diff as a secondary toggle inside the diff panel.

harry: accessibility nit: the diff panel must respect reduced-motion settings — don't animate height jumps for users who prefer reduced motion. also when it opens, move focus into the panel and set aria-live='polite' to announce "Schema diff expanded".

lisa: on narration: the SR should read a short summary like "InvoiceSchema changed: 2 fields added, 1 removed" rather than reading the entire diff. provide a link "Read full diff" that brings keyboard users to the detailed list.

nina: good. microcopy question: button label options: "View schema changes" vs "Show schema diff" vs "Schema diff". which is best?

sam: "View schema changes" is clearer to non-technical users. "diff" might be jargon.

maya: agree. use "View schema changes" for primary. keep an icon-only control with title attr for power users who want compactness.

harry: implementation note: run history is virtualized — we should lazy-render diff content when opened to avoid perf hits. also emit telemetry: event run_diff_opened with schema_version_from/to so we can measure frequency.

lisa: telemetry is great — but ensure PII isn't leaked in events. sanitize IDs. Also for SR: if a user opens multiple diffs quickly, debounce announcements so screen readers don't get spammed (200-300ms).

sam: another ux thought: when a schema change is backward-incompatible we should surface a red badge "breaking" and a short hint: "May require prompt updates". copy for the hint?

maya: copy: "Potentially breaking change — may affect callers". keep it terse. add a tooltip on focus that explains how to roll back or pin a model version.

nina: coachmark idea: for first-time users who hit the playground Run History, show a small non-modal coachmark pointing at the new control: "New: view schema changes for tool outputs" with a "Don't show again" checkbox. A11y: ensure it's dismissible via keyboard and that it doesn't steal focus.

lisa: coachmarks can be problematic if they are not accessible. prefer an inline hint line that is part of the DOM and focusable. if we still add a coachmark, make sure it is aria-describedby to the control and doesn't trap focus. include a visible "Esc" hint to dismiss.

harry: also support reduced-motion for coachmark entry animation. and respect user preference for "hide coachmarks" in account settings.

sam: testing idea: A/B test two variants — coachmark vs inline hint — and measure feature discovery + time-to-understand via telemetry. event names: coachmark_shown, coachmark_dismissed, schema_changes_viewed.

nina: design nit: diff panel layout — left column shows field names with small status chips (added/removed/changed), right column shows sample type and a tiny example. chips need strong contrast (WCAG AA). don't rely on color alone — add icons for add/remove/change.

maya: yes, include text labels on chips for color-blind users. also make sure chips are keyboard-focusable if they're interactive (e.g., filter to added fields).

lisa: aria: each diff row should be a listitem with an accessible name like "added field: billing_address" and the type announced after. for changed types announce "billing_address: type changed from string to object". keep sentences short.

harry: for very large diffs, collapse groups by namespace and show counts "3 changes in invoice.items" to avoid overwhelming users. allow expanding groups. aria-announcements for group expansion: "Expanded items group, 3 changes".

sam: small implementation quirk: when users click "View schema changes" from a virtualized offscreen row, ensure the panel renders in-place or moves to a persistent side panel. rendering in-place is trickier with virtualization but better contextual linkage. maybe fallback: if row is offscreen, open in right-side persistent panel with breadcrumb back to the row.

nina: agree. fallback to side panel if virtualization doesn't allow in-place expansion. UX should show a clear link: "Back to run".

maya: copy tweak for the side panel header: "Schema changes for InvoiceParser (v12 -> v13)" — include versions. aria-label should include full version numbers for SR. truncate visually but keep full string in aria-label.

lisa: final accessibility checklist suggestion: focus management, reduced-motion, live regions for summaries, aria-describedby for badges, keyboard dismissible coachmark, and clear SR-friendly copy for diff rows. I'll write a short spec.

ux-bot: branch "runhistory-schema-diff" created from nina/ui. preview will be posted after CI.

nina: thanks team — i'll drop mocks and a short spec doc here once I finish. :raised_hands:
